sourceTitle: Gliders on Aperiodic Monotilings: Cellular Automata on the Hat and Spectre
simple: D is the documented three-state reduction of Hat B with the two-empty-neighbour birth condition removed; this is a variant, not an equivalent rule on arbitrary inputs.
selectedSeedProvenance: Deterministic connected-seed search on independently generated finite hat patches, 13 October2026. Seeds and finite dynamics are new to this campaign. No historical priority claim is made for launching or periodic-emission mechanisms.
catalogueInterpretation: Credit Edmond for the unchanged Hat A/B rules. Separate the newly recorded seed, finite verification and repeating-source evidence from any claim of an indefinitely firing gun.
